source.supplied_as: Screenshot of the selection table supplied by the user. No PDF was provided, so no file hash is recorded and the figures cannot be traced to a page. Confirm against the controlled datasheet before using any of this in a specification.

footnotes_as_printed: 1. Capacities are rated with 100% Water - Capacities will vary depending on application.
3. Consult factory for optional connection types.
conflict: Footnote 1 says capacities are rated with 100% water, while the capacity rows are labelled 25% PG on the secondary. The two cannot both be literally true; the row labels are used here because they carry the temperatures.

derived_checks.capacity_scales_with_secondary_rise_at_f: 113F/149F is a 20 K rise and gives 5040 kW; 112F/122F is 5.56 K and gives 1400 kW. 2500 kW x 20/10 = 5000 and 2500 x 5.56/10 = 1389, so the table is self-consistent with a nominal 10 K rise on the 2500 kW row.
derived_checks.nominal_flow_reproduces_the_rating: 991 GPM is 0.06252 m3/s. At 2500 kW with PG25 near 50 C (rho about 1020, cp about 3900) the implied rise is 10.05 K, which is RD113's published 45 to 55 C.
derived_checks.rating_condition_matches_rd113: The 2500 kW row is primary 105.8 F (41.0 C) with secondary 25% PG at 113 F (45.0 C). RD113 publishes FWS 40 C supply and TCS 45 C supply, so the 2.5 MW figure in RD113_4.2 is the rating at this design's own temperatures, not a generic headline.

not_published: Pressure drop curve for either side; the available pump head is the head the unit delivers, not its internal loss, so cdu_design_dp_kPa remains a declared project input.
Approach temperature per model. RD113_4.2 states 4 C for the MCDU-70; this table does not.
